title: Spleen segmentation and volumetry from abdominal CT

source.attribution: Simpson et al. 2019 arXiv:1902.09063; Antonelli et al. Nat Commun 2022;13:4128. Data: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center via the Medical Segmentation Decathlon. Modified: cropped to body outline, re-encoded int16, headers cleaned, re-identified case IDs. Share-alike: derived task data stay CC BY-SA 4.0.

generated.environment/data/dev/volumes.csv: case,spleen_volume_ml from label voxel count x |det(affine[:3,:3])|/1000, 2 decimals

agent_visible.instruction: task/README.md with placeholders filled per tier

solution.note: The Harbor oracle is the classical reference: it proves the contract is satisfiable from agent-visible material, not that 1.0 is reachable. The grader's 1.0 self-check uses selfcheck/oracle with hidden labels, locally only.

reward_definition.ran: fraction of hidden cases with exit 0 and no timeout
reward_definition.valid: fraction with mask on input grid, labels 0/1, volume.json finite and within 1% / 0.5 mL of mask voxels x voxel volume
reward_definition.within_time: fraction finished within case_time_limit_sec on the grader's monotonic clock
reward_definition.clinically_acceptable: fraction with valid, in-time output, Dice >= 0.94 and |relative volume error| <= 0.10
reward_definition.quality: mean Dice over hidden cases (0 for invalid or late cases)
reward_definition.vs_specialist: min(1, quality / specialist mean Dice on the same hidden cases)
reward_definition.reward: clinically_acceptable if ran == valid == within_time == 1 else 0

thresholds.source: Humpire-Mamani GE et al. Fully automatic volume measurement of the spleen at CT using deep learning. Radiol Artif Intell 2020;2(4):e190102 (PMC8082410): independent observer vs reference, 50 CT scans, Dice 0.964 +/- 0.012, mean relative absolute volume difference 3.93 %. Dice limit = mean - 2 SD; volume limit = 95th percentile of |e| if e ~ N(0, s) with E|e| = 3.93 % (1.96 * 3.93 * sqrt(pi/2) = 9.65 %, rounded to 10 %). Fixed 2026-11-14 before any agent run.

build.torch_note: CPU-only PyTorch, no pretrained weights. Set include_torch=false to build the no-torch variant.

readme_fill.TORCH_LINE: , and CPU-only PyTorch with no pretrained weights
